# Noloco

Noloco is a no-code platform for building internal tools, client portals, and business applications backed by a dynamic GraphQL data API.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/noloco/.

## Actions

- **Create Record**: Create one record in a table in the connected Noloco app.
- **Delete Record**: Permanently delete one record from a Noloco table by ID.
- **Describe Table** (read-only): Describe one Noloco table's selectable fields, unique lookup selectors, filters, and create/update inputs.
- **Get Record** (read-only): Fetch one record from a Noloco table by a supported unique selector.
- **List Records** (read-only): Return one forward-paginated page of records from a table in the connected Noloco app.
- **List Tables** (read-only): List the record tables and generated CRUD operation names available in the connected Noloco app.
- **Update Record**: Partially update one Noloco record by ID.
